edit_reversal: Apply each file's edits in reverse order, replacing every exact after string with its before string and requiring the stored occurrence count. Complete disk readback reverses byte-for-byte to the retained original. All original and successor bytes are ASCII, so these offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets.

accounting.unit: Every actual allocation request receives its own max_align_t-aligned prefix holding the originating native memory owner and exact prefix+payload charge. No capacity-derived reservation substitutes for a real allocation.
allocation_order: reserve that exact charge in the actual atomic native memory owner
on malloc failure, roll back only that charge and set the active Scope failure bit
on success, separately retain the original native memory owner and construct the prefix
release_order: load the block's original owner and charge
destroy prefix and free its actual allocation
release the block's original native owner entitlement
accounting.domain: A stack Scope retains its actual memory owner and links a thread-local prior Scope. Native parser actions are synchronous; no Engine or JS value enters Scope or Allocation. Leaving Scope restores the prior domain. Every successful block independently survives that scope and can release on another native thread without an active Scope.
accounting.failure: Actual reserve/malloc or checked-size failure sets a sticky bit only on the active Scope. Old blocks and earlier successful replacement blocks retain exact charges. Zero count still goes through a real prefix-sized allocation, matching an actual array allocation lifetime.
accounting.alignment: Allocation is max_align_t aligned and its size is a multiple of that alignment. Array element and all eight derived backend object alignments are statically admitted.
accounting.arrays: Only selected trivial element arrays change their unique_ptr deleter and new expression. Each trivial element lifetime starts with placement default-initialization; no value initialization/zeroing is added. Reset retains the original evaluate-new-before-free-old order.
accounting.object: Only the internal parser implementation class gains allocation/deallocation operators. The eight actual backend new(nothrow) factory expressions and virtual destructor selection are unchanged. No global operator new override.

static const std::initializer_list<const implementation *>& get_available_implementation_pointers() {

#if SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_ICELAKE

library.conclusion: On the admitted 64-bit libc++ target both actual layouts have sizeof(__long)==24 and char min_cap==23. The exact string_view constructor reaches __init, whose size<min_cap branch selects inline storage without allocator invocation. All eight selected names fit. This is a pinned-library source conclusion; no blanket C++ SSO assumption.
